name: Antigua Guatemala
description: Discover the colonial streets, colorful buildings, historic churches, and beautiful views of the volcanoes surrounding Antigua Guatemala.

name: Lake Atitlan
description: Enjoy one of Guatemala's most beautiful lakes, surrounded by volcanoes, traditional Mayan villages, and breathtaking mountain scenery.

name: Tikal National Park
description: Explore the ancient Mayan city of Tikal, famous for its impressive pyramids, archaeological ruins, and wildlife in the tropical rainforest.

name: Semuc Champey
description: Visit the turquoise natural pools formed over a limestone bridge and enjoy the lush forests and rivers of this spectacular destination.

name: Acatenango Volcano
description: Challenge yourself with a volcano hike and enjoy incredible views of the surrounding mountains and the nearby Fuego Volcano.

name: Rio Dulce
description: Travel along a beautiful river surrounded by tropical vegetation, peaceful waterways, and rich wildlife in eastern Guatemala.

name: Livingston
description: Experience Garifuna culture, Caribbean cuisine, lively music, and a unique coastal atmosphere on Guatemala's Caribbean side.

name: Chichicastenango
description: Explore the famous traditional market, colorful textiles, handmade crafts, and cultural traditions of this highland town.

name: Pacaya Volcano
description: Enjoy an accessible volcano adventure with impressive volcanic landscapes, rocky trails, and views of the surrounding countryside.

name: Flores
description: Walk through colorful streets beside Lake Petén Itzá, admire the waterfront views, and discover the history of this charming island town.

name: Monterrico
description: Relax on volcanic black-sand beaches, watch beautiful sunsets, and learn about local sea turtle conservation efforts.

name: Yaxha National Park
description: Discover an ancient Mayan archaeological site surrounded by rainforest, with temple ruins and memorable views over Lake Yaxhá.

name: Quetzaltenango
description: Discover Guatemala's western highlands, historic architecture, local markets, traditional food, and nearby mountain landscapes.

name: Todos Santos Cuchumatán
description: Learn about the distinctive Mam Maya traditions, traditional clothing, and mountain scenery of this highland community.

name: Iximche
description: Visit the archaeological remains of an important Kaqchikel Maya capital and learn about Guatemala's pre-Columbian history.
